messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Financial Transactions" as it appears in the following examples.
['OUR SECURITY DEPARTMENT HAVE NOTICED AN ILLEGAL MONEY TRANSFER FROM your HSBC internet banking account.', 'We ask for your support financially and otherwise.remember your little contribution will go along way to change their situation.', 'We are unable to process this payment to your account as your details has not been updated to our new database', 'Make payments or send money.', 'You have an incoming payment selected for your account.', 'You shall arrange for us to meet with you immediately you claim the fund from the security company.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by BT Internet to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'After this period, the required sum will be taken from your default payment option and the signup will be activated.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We report payment issues, incoming transfers, and account updates, while requesting financial support, arranging fund claims, and explaining payment processing."}
